LESSON: MASS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: MEASUREMENT
Topic 2.2: Mass
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Mass, part of MEASUREMENT in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: How can you make a 1kg mass using a beam balance?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Mass together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: Signing and observing in groups, use items of the same mass and an improvised beam balance

to measure different masses, record and discuss the results,

Values:
• Integrity: honesty in measuring mass of different objects and sharing own findings with others.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Safety of self and others to avoid accidents as they collect materials to be used to measure mass in their immediate environment.

Link to other learning areas:

• Learner relates measuring skills to consumer education in Environmental activities.

Suggested Learning resources:

● Masses of 1kg, soil, sand, beam balance
